title: shilp-sutra BREAKING manifest
description: Machine-readable record of breaking changes per published version. Lets AI agents and migration tools answer 'what breaks between X and Y?' programmatically instead of parsing CHANGELOG prose. Cumulative — every prior version's breaks remain so a consumer jumping 0.37 → 0.41 can see every break in range.

package.description: npm package name this manifest covers.

versions.description: Map of semver version → breaking-change record. A version only appears if it had at least one breaking change. Non-breaking releases are absent (an empty object would falsely signal 'this version had breaks I forgot to document').

versionEntry.description: All breaks shipped in this version. Every present field is an array; omit empty fields entirely. A consumer planning an upgrade reads the union of all entries between current and target version.

summary.description: One-line human summary of the version's breaks. Mirrors the `> ⚠️ Breaking in X.Y.Z` callout in CHANGELOG.

migrationDoc.description: Relative path inside the package tarball to the human migration guide for this version.

moved.description: Symbols whose import path changed. Old path no longer exports the symbol; new path does. Consumer fix is a search-and-replace of the import path; prop/type signatures are unchanged.

narrowed.description: Prop types that accept LESS than before. A consumer value valid under the old type may now fail tsc. Not a runtime break. The fix is typically retyping the value's source.

removed.description: Symbols (components, props, variants, exports) deleted with no replacement on the same path. If a renamed-with-deprecation, list under `renamed` instead.

renamed.description: Symbols whose name changed in place (same import path, new export name) or whose prop name changed (same component, new prop name).

notes.description: Free-form breaking changes that don't fit the structured categories above (e.g. visual-only changes, DOM structure shifts, default-value flips). Reader must check these manually — the migration is NOT one-shot autofixable.

symbol.description: Exported name as it appears in an import statement.

from.description: Old import path (no longer exports this symbol after this version).

to.description: New import path (exports this symbol going forward).

peer.description: Optional. If this move was driven by a peer-cliff cleanup, the peer dependency the new subpath pulls.

eslintRule.description: Optional. The `@devalok/eslint-plugin-shilp-sutra` rule that autofixes this move.

components.description: Components whose this-prop narrowed. List each affected component explicitly — the same prop name on a component whose type was already narrower than the new type is NOT affected.

from.description: Previous TypeScript type, as a string. Use the exact source form.

to.description: New TypeScript type, as a string. Must be a subset of `from` (otherwise it's a widening, not a narrowing).

fix.description: One-line consumer fix. Should be actionable from the type alone.
examples: Retype the icon source from React.ReactNode to React.ReactElement.

where.description: What the symbol was on — a component, an import path, or a token namespace.

replacement.description: Optional. If a replacement exists at the same site, name it. If there is none, omit.

deprecatedSince.description: Optional. The version that first emitted a deprecation warning, if a cycle was observed.

where.description: Component or import path the rename applies to.
